description: This file defines the TransactionalStateFactory class which implements ITransactionalStateFactory. It provides methods to create transactional state instances and configure JSON serializer settings within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: TransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Implements ITransactionalStateFactory to create transactional state instances and manage JSON serialization settings.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new transactional state instance for the specified type TState using the current grain context.

methods.name: GetJsonSerializerSettings
methods.description: Configures and returns JSON serializer settings with reference preservation disabled.
